ns2:section.sectionText: Thinking, Reasoning, and Problem-Solving, 3 hours. An overview of reserach on thinking, reasoning, and problem-solving. Topics will include creativity and insight, problem-solving through analogy, logic and other systems of reasoning, models of decision-making and choice, and fast and frugal decision-making strategies. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen James Scholars. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Meets with PHIL 199 section DC. https://netfiles.uiuc.edu/dcummins/www/HomePage/index.html
